notes.v: Common Problems: Cylinder head cracks (severe overheating), timing chain wear/noise at high mileage, injection pump seal leaks, turbo wear/oil leakage, glow plug failure (hard cold start), EGR carbon buildup. Maintenance: Fuel filter every 20,000km, Air filter 15,000-20,000km, Coolant every 40,000km, Oil change 7,500-10,000km, valve clearance periodic check. Power: NA 80HP/198Nm, Turbo 125HP/294Nm, Turbo+Intercooler 140HP/314Nm. 4M40 mechanical distributor pump-ல் individual injector solenoid wiring இல்ல — injection quantity/timing pump-க்குள்ளேயே mechanically அல்லது pump-mounted timing control device மூலம் நடக்கும் (electronic control unit வேற, injector driver circuit தனியா இல்ல). Braking (ABS/brake system) இந்த app-ல் தனி category இல்ல — scope-ல் இல்ல. ECU flash/reprogramming procedures Mitsubishi proprietary tool (MUT-II/MUT-III) தேவைப்படும் — அதுக்கான exact flash codes/part numbers confidently verify பண்ண முடியலை.
